title: 🚨 WHAT IF THE “VOICE OF GOD” YOU’RE FOLLOWING… ISN’T GOD?
paragraphs: 🚨 WHAT IF THE “VOICE OF GOD” YOU’RE FOLLOWING… ISN’T GOD?
A strong feeling is not automatically the Holy Spirit.
A dream is not automatically revelation.
An open door is not automatically God's will.
And saying “God told me” doesn't make something true.
That should challenge every serious believer.
Because deception rarely introduces itself by saying, “I'm here to deceive you.”
Sometimes it sounds spiritual.
Sometimes it feels convincing.
Sometimes it even comes wrapped in Bible verses taken out of context.
HOW TO HEAR GOD'S VOICE WITHOUT BEING DECEIVED
Know the Word. Test the voice. Follow Jesus.
This isn't a book about chasing mystical experiences.

It's about becoming so grounded in Scripture, Christ, prayer, wisdom, and biblical discernment that you stop treating every thought, feeling, dream, coincidence, or spiritual impression as God's voice.
The Bible itself commands:
“Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God.” — 1 John 4:1
🔥 INSIDE THIS BOOK, YOU'LL DISCOVER:

• How to test what you believe you're hearing against Scripture
• How to distinguish conviction from condemnation
• How your own desires can masquerade as divine direction
• Why “I feel peace about it” isn't always enough
• How to approach dreams, signs, coincidences, and open doors wisely
• Warning signs of manipulation disguised as prophecy or spiritual authority
• Why mature Christian counsel can protect you from blind spots
• A practical 7-Test Discernment Filter for major decisions
• How to grow in confidence without becoming spiritually gullible
• How to pursue Jesus instead of becoming obsessed with supernatural experiences
⚔️ HERE'S THE CONTRAST:
Most people want God to confirm what they already want.
Few are willing to let Scripture correct them.
Most people want another sign.
Few become deeply rooted in the Word.
Most people ask, “Does this feel right?”
Few ask, “Is this actually biblical?”
Most people want spiritual experiences.
Few want the humility required for spiritual discernment.
Which kind of believer are you becoming?
⚔️ THIS IS BIGGER THAN ONE BOOK.
We're building a community of believers who don't want shallow Christianity.
Believers who open their Bibles.
Believers who test what they hear.
Believers who welcome correction.
Believers who choose truth over feelings.
Believers who want to know Jesus—not merely collect spiritual experiences.
If that describes the believer you want to become:
Grow in discernment.
Help us keep creating resources that proclaim Christ and spread God's Word.
Then do three things:

KNOW THE WORD.
TEST THE VOICE.
FOLLOW JESUS.
⚔️ GOSPEL WARRIOR
